## Live Probe & Documentation Notes (2026-11-25)
- Public/keyless `/models` HTTP 200 verified (2026-11-25): wafer-serverless (13), zenmux (220), nvidia-nim (30), openrouter (472), opencode-go (108), opencode-zen (108), ollama (3 local default check), cline (458), kilo (467), commandcode (105), fastino (14), nous-portal (409).
- Auth-gated `/models` returning 400/401/403/404 when unkeyed on clean host: nebius, nebius-us-north1, moonshot, modal, modal-proxy, typesafe, xiaomi-mimo, zai, antigravity, github-copilot, cursor.
- Z.ai GLM-5.4 verified (2026-11-25): docs.z.ai documents 1,000,000 (1M) context and 131,072 (128K) max output with text/image/video/file inputs and Loop Transformer thinking (`thinking.type` / `reasoning_effort` low/high/max); live `:11434` probe to `zai/glm-5.4` returned HTTP 200 with `reasoning_tokens` billed.

Endpoint: https://pass.wafer.ai/v1
Auth env: WAFER_SERVERLESS_API_KEY
Registry note: Wafer serverless pass (replaced deprecated wafer-pass 2026-05-26)
Reasoning: dialect=openai-effort, levels=[none, minimal, low, medium, high], default=medium, acceptsXhigh=false
Reasoning note: llms.txt §Thinking (family mapping); measured 2026-11-07 on ZenMux for deepseek-v4.1-flash
Caching: mechanism=implicit-prefix, maxBreakpoints=0, ttl=null, stickyKey=prompt_cache_key
Caching note: docs/caching/wafer-serverless.txt — automatic radix prefix cache; cache_read price exposed in /v1/models; sticky prompt_cache_key anchors the cache where honoured and is ignored where not [INFERENCE: acceptance unstated]
